paragraphs.source_en: xviii PREFACE TO THE SECOND EDITION In the first edition, I focused more on startups. In this edition, however, I wanted to expand the scope to look at the challenges of growth-stage companies and how product can be done well at large, enterprise companies. There’s no question that scale introduces serious challenges, and over the past decade, much of my time has been spent coaching companies through rapid growth. Sometimes we call that surviving success, if that gives you an indication of how hard it can be. I’ve received a lot of great feedback from readers of the first edition, and there are a couple of important things I’ve learned that I would like to address here. First, there really is a critical need to focus on the specific job of the product manager. In the first edition, I talked a lot about product management, but I tried to speak to product teams more broadly.
